title: Choose the visual world
question: The roll assigned the Take-a-Number Counter. Keep it, take an alternate, or re-roll.

options.label: Take-a-Number Counter
options.lineage: barbershop and deli 'take a number' dispensers with red NOW SERVING displays
options.thesis: The whole site is the queue: pull a ticket, get in the chair.
options.viewport: A giant red NOW SERVING LED counter beside a dispenser; pulling the ticket tab opens contact (phone, email, IG).
options.risk: Reads gimmicky if the ticket metaphor spreads into every section instead of the hero and contact.

raised.raise: Gallery cuts repeat as identical ticket-sized frames, so the row reads as one ruler.
Layout snaps to whole ticket units; nothing sits at a fractional size.
Red is spent in one place per screen: the counter, then the ticket you pull.

options.label: Dorm Flyer Wall
options.lineage: photocopied campus flyers with tear-off phone tabs
options.thesis: A flyer on the dorm corkboard, tear a tab to book.
options.viewport: One huge photocopied flyer with tear-off contact tabs along the bottom.
options.risk: Familiar: this is where most student-service sites land, and it can look cheap.

options.label: VU Meter Bridge
options.risk: Students do not read a barber through audio gear.
options.case: Loses on both axes: no link between a fade and a meter.
options.kept: Identical units repeated as a ruler.

options.label: Azulejo Station Hall
options.risk: Cobalt breaks the pinned red and black.
options.case: Conflicts with the brief's colours and the audience.

options.label: Civic Bureau Prospectus
options.thesis: All colour spent on one ribbon.
options.risk: Corporate; wrong for a dorm barber.
options.kept: All colour spent in one place.

options.label: Bioluminescent Wake
options.viewport: A dark field lit by trails.
options.risk: Blue glow breaks the pinned palette.
options.kept: Darkness at rest, light only where touched.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A barber site done cleanly: photo hero, gallery grid, contact.
canonCard.viewport: A big cut photo with the name and a Book button.
canonCard.risk: Looks like every other barber site.
